business_summary: Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. produces and sells vacuum equipment and components for quartz devices, optical thin films, and electronic devices in Japan, China, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Vacuum Technology Application Equipment Business and Service Business segments. The company provides vacuum-related equipment and vacuum components for quartz devices, optical thin films, electronic devices, vacuum evaporation equipment, sputtering equipment, ion plating equipment, ALD equipment, dry etching/ashing equipment, vacuum metallurgical (dissolution, heat treatment, sintering, and degassing equipment, optical monitor for thin films, including multi-color, monochrome, IAD cold cathode ion source. Its products are used in smartphone, automobile, medical, energy, virtual reality, space, and decorative industries. The company was formerly known as Showa Shinku Kikai (Showa Vacuum Machinery) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. in 1978. Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.
